title: Subtree of Another Tree
statement:
Given two binary trees root and subRoot, return true if there is a subtree of root with the same structure and node values as subRoot, and false otherwise.

A subtree of a binary tree is a tree that consists of a node in the original tree and all of this node's descendants.

visibleExamples.explanation: The tree rooted at node 4 is a subtree of root and has the same structure and values as subRoot.
The tree rooted at node 4 has an additional child node 0, so it is not the same as subRoot.

jsonFriendlyReason: Requires TreeNode adapter for root and subRoot parameters.
